purpose: Commission the coverage ledger classifier. It reported AS_DECLARED on the first dataset it was pointed at, which is the answer it was built to give - so it is not evidence until it has been shown to give different answers (P9).
method: compare() driven against synthetic Snapshots. No database touched.

cases: undeclared loss is reported (the case the ledger exists for)
declared-but-absent fails, reported separately from unexpected
HOLDS over 0 counts as deactivated even though the status did not move
a population appearing counts as activated
a declared status change is clean
declaring the WRONG status does not excuse it
reported as Changed, not Lost, and does not by itself fail the ledger

design_notes.surface_granularity: keyed as endpoint__resolver, not collapsed to endpoint. The first version collapsed them and reported no gain for main.reservation_folio, whose inhouse_reservation variant had never resolved. Collapsing also hides an endpoint keeping one working variant while another stops resolving.
design_notes.date_normalisation: dates in surface keys are normalised to YYYY_MM_DD. Report surfaces are pinned to the business date, so comparing literally produced 6 spurious additions and 6 spurious losses on every dataset. A surface that does not resolve at all is still reported as lost.
design_notes.declared_statuses: expectations.invariants is consulted rather than duplicated in coverage_expectation, so one intent is not declared twice in two places that can drift.
